Question: Mere ek buzurg ne khwab me dekha ke Dr Manmohan Singh"pardhan mantiri" ek namaz ki Imamat kar rahe hen.Brai meher bani iski tabeer batayen. Answer ID: 3140 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1974/1516=H) Leading salah means his leadership and rendering of party affairs. The dream indicates also that he has passion to give benefit to Muslims and Islam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
